items.name: echo-modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: Base UI Dialog (focus trap, Esc, scroll-lock, a11y) skinned as an Echo device panel. motion.summon enter, GSAP exit that completes before unmount, sound.transition on open.

items.name: echo-menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Base UI Menu (typeahead, roving focus, submenu timing, checkbox/radio items) skinned as an Echo floating panel — the Select's molded cap trigger and the same lit dot for what is on. sound.transition on open, sound.select on item commit. Exports ContextMenu for the right-click case.

items.name: echo-sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A molded chassis panel that slides in from an edge — the console side panel and the mobile nav. Built on Base UI's Drawer, so it carries swipe-to-dismiss and a backdrop that tracks the swipe. sound.transition on open.

items.name: echo-alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: A destructive confirm. Modal covers the structure; this is the semantics — role=alertdialog, a required description, and no dismissal by clicking away. sound.caution on open, sound.error on a destructive confirm. Severity is the deep end of the accent ramp, never an imported red.

items.name: echo-size
items.title: SizeProvider
items.description: One size scale for everything with a height: sm, md and lg are the control heights, so a button, a field and a select of the same size line up in a row.

items.name: echo-scope
items.title: Scope
items.description: A part of the page with its own accent or softer molding, derived by the theme engine.

items.name: echo-hardware-button
items.title: HardwareButton
items.description: The molded tactile button: a cap in a recessed well with real press travel + sound. primary/neutral/ghost, sm/md/lg, icon slots, icon-only, loading, engraved. Built on semantic vars + useTactile.

items.name: echo-popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Base UI Popover (anchoring, focus, dismiss, a11y) skinned as an Echo panel. useGsapPresence summon-in / GSAP exit before unmount; sound.select on open.

items.name: echo-tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Base UI Tooltip (hover/focus, delay, a11y) skinned as a compact molded chip. Same useGsapPresence bridge as Modal/Popover.

items.name: echo-select
items.title: Select
items.description: Base UI Select (typeahead, keyboard, a11y) skinned as an Echo dropdown — a molded cap trigger and a floating panel with a lit dot on the selected option. CSS fade/scale; sound.select on change.

items.name: echo-command
items.title: Command
items.description: The command palette as a dot-matrix readout — the query line is the LcdChip's recessed screen well with an emissive caret and a scanline wash. Base UI Autocomplete for the input and listbox semantics, Base UI Dialog for the frame. Cmd/Ctrl+K by default; matches hidden keywords as well as labels.

items.name: echo-tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Base UI Tabs (roving focus, arrow-key nav, a11y) marked with the library's one "you are here": a 2px lit rail slides under the open tab, over a hairline baseline. Labels stay on the chassis. sound.select on change. Compound API.

items.name: echo-accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Base UI Accordion (keyboard, a11y, height measurement) skinned as molded device panels that expand. Click sound on toggle; height animates via CSS. Compound API.

items.name: echo-switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Base UI Switch (role=switch, keyboard, a11y) with a hardware-toggle skin — a molded thumb sliding in a recessed track — and a click sound on toggle.

items.name: echo-checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Base UI Checkbox (keyboard, indeterminate, a11y) with a molded box skin that fills accent and shows a check when set. Select sound on change.

items.name: echo-slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Base UI Slider (keyboard, drag, track-press, a11y) with a recessed rail + molded knob and a scrubbing tick sound on each step.

items.name: echo-segmented
items.title: Segmented
items.description: A hardware segmented selector — molded uppercase segments in a recessed well, the active one on the lit primary cap. A radiogroup value selector (roving focus, arrow-key select, select sound), distinct from Tabs which switches content panels.

items.name: echo-field
items.title: Field
items.description: A text input sunk into a recessed well. The inner edge lights in the accent on focus; a mono eyebrow label and an optional machine (mono) value voice.

items.name: echo-date-field
items.title: DateField
items.description: A date typed into wheels, day, month and year in the order the locale writes them, each a row of small flaps that turn over to the value. Field's recessed well, on the same size scale; the value is an ISO date.

items.name: echo-calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month on a device screen: the days are its lit segments, the chosen day lit with the one lit accent and today on a lit rail. A grid with one Tab stop and the calendar keys; the value is an ISO date.

items.name: echo-date-picker
items.title: DatePicker
items.description: A DateField with a calendar key in its well: type the date, or choose it on a Calendar that opens under the field. The value is an ISO date.

items.name: echo-file-upload
items.title: FileUpload
items.description: A recessed tray you press to choose files or drop them on; its inner edge lights while files are over it. Each file becomes a row with a Progress strip while your handler uploads it, and a key to cancel, retry or remove it.

items.name: echo-textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Field's recessed well, multi-line and autosizing. The height is measured from the browser's own layout rather than counted from newlines, so it stays right when lines wrap and when the container resizes.

items.name: echo-badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small molded/LCD status label: neutral, accent, lcd, outline. Static; composes var(--echo-*).

items.name: echo-kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A molded keycap for keyboard hints. Uses the <kbd> element; composes var(--echo-*).

items.name: echo-divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A panel seam — a hairline with a faint light lip. Horizontal or vertical; role=separator.

items.name: echo-stat-tile
items.title: StatTile
items.description: A recessed LCD readout: a glowing value over a machine label in a dark well. Static; composes var(--echo-*).

items.name: echo-chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: StatTile's dot-matrix language applied to a series: a column per sample, cells lit from the bottom, in the recessed screen well LcdChip and Progress use. Quantises to whole cells by construction — a readout, not a charting library.

items.name: echo-app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: The app frame: a molded chassis rail, a sticky sidebar, and the content between them. Slots, not props. Ships the skip link by construction and derives the sidebar's sticky offset from the rail's height.

items.name: echo-panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: The two halves of the device material law as a container: raised molded plastic (things you touch) or a recessed dark screen (things you read).

items.name: echo-progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A discrete LED cell meter in a recessed strip — filled cells are lit accent LEDs with a bloom. Steppy by construction; role=progressbar.

items.name: echo-loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Three accent LEDs breathing in sequence — the device thinking. role=status; reduced motion holds the dots steady.

items.name: echo-status-dot
items.title: StatusDot
items.description: A tiny LED — lit accent with a bloom, or dead plastic gray. Decorative (aria-hidden) unless given a label.

items.name: echo-toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A raised glass notification slab with a status LED — lit accent when active. Presentational (role=status); queueing stays in the consumer.

items.name: echo-status-island
items.title: StatusIsland
items.description: Background work in a floating pill that blooms open for detail.

items.name: echo-receipt
items.title: Receipt
items.description: A summary that feeds out of a slot a line at a time, on paper you tear off.

items.name: echo-ticket
items.title: Ticket
items.description: A paper pass whose stub tears off along its perforation.

items.name: echo-now-playing
items.title: NowPlaying
items.description: A small player: a screen, a strip to scrub, the transport keys.

items.name: echo-lcd-chip
items.title: LcdChip
items.description: An inline recessed LCD readout — a glowing accent value beside a machine label, sunk into a dark well. The chip form of StatTile.

items.name: echo-segment-display
items.title: SegmentDisplay
items.description: A seven-segment readout whose dark segments stay faintly visible, with dim padding zeros.

items.name: echo-date-tile
items.title: DateTile
items.description: A desk calendar's page: weekday and month engraved, the day lit on a screen.

items.name: echo-annunciator
items.title: Annunciator
items.description: Fixed marks on a screen's glass that light when what they name is happening.

items.name: echo-led-key
items.title: LedKey
items.description: A molded pill key with an indicator LED that breathes while lit. The latching sibling of HardwareButton — for a key whose own state is part of the answer.

items.name: echo-engraved-plate
items.title: EngravedPlate
items.description: A paper-coloured metal plate with text cut into it and rivets at the edges — the one non-emissive readout. For a fact fixed to the device, where LcdChip is for a live value.

items.name: echo-textures
items.title: Textures
items.description: The grain law as composable overlays: Dither, Noise, Halftone, Scanlines, plus GrainField and Textured. Inline SVG tiles, no asset files; decorative and pointer-events-free.

items.name: echo-shader-field
items.title: ShaderField
items.description: The live brand field — a WebGL domain-warped fbm gradient sampled from the accent ramp, blooming toward the cursor. Reduced motion draws one static frame; no WebGL falls back to a CSS gradient.

items.name: echo-radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: One choice from a small set, as molded selector caps with a pip that lights accent when chosen. Base UI owns roving focus and arrow-key selection.

items.name: echo-otp-field
items.title: OTP field
items.description: The one-time code a sign-in asks for, as a row of lit digit windows. Built on Base UI's OTP Field: paste fills the row, arrow keys and Backspace walk it, and autocomplete="one-time-code" lets a phone offer the code.

items.name: echo-number-field
items.title: NumberField
items.description: A machined readout between two molded step caps, with the label doubling as a drag-to-scrub handle. Base UI owns typing, arrow keys, step sizes, and clamping.

items.name: echo-avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person or device as a molded disc — image in a well, or initials engraved into the plastic when there is no image or it fails to load.

items.name: echo-tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A label the user applied, optionally removable. Badge reports what the system knows; Tag is a small plate that can be peeled off.

items.name: echo-count-badge
items.title: CountBadge
items.description: A number worth noticing — the lit sibling of Badge. Disappears at zero, caps its face at max while still announcing the true count.

items.name: echo-skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: The shape of content that has not arrived: a recess with a slow sheen. aria-hidden by default; one label announces the wait for the whole region.

items.name: echo-banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A persistent inline message strip for a condition that is still true. Severity by luminance and a tone pip, not by hues the seed does not own.

items.name: echo-empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: Nothing here, and what to do about it — a quiet recess with the way forward built into the API.

items.name: echo-creature
items.title: Creature
items.description: A companion that reports what's happening: Echo, or your own, as a vector or in dots.

items.name: echo-perch
items.title: Perch
items.description: A creature on a card's top edge, sitting or peeking.

items.name: echo-table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of data in a recessed screen well. Real table semantics, a required caption, tabular figures for numbers, and a scroll region that keyboard users can reach. Given columns and rows, it sorts, selects, filters and windows them.

items.name: echo-description-list
items.title: DescriptionList
items.description: Things and their values, on the page or on a screen.

items.name: echo-shortcut-map
items.title: ShortcutMap
items.description: A keyboard of Kbd caps over the list of shortcuts, lighting each one's keys.

items.name: echo-widget-grid
items.title: WidgetGrid
items.description: Widgets at fixed footprints that people arrange, by drag or by key.

items.name: echo-breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where you are in the hierarchy, as an engraved trail. Labelled nav around an ordered list; the current page is text with aria-current, not a link.

items.name: echo-pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Molded number caps with the current page lit. The window never elides a single page and never changes width as you page through.

items.name: echo-steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: How far through a sequence you are, as LED stations on a wire. aria-current on the current station; the done state reaches screen readers as words, not colour.

items.name: echo-card
items.title: Card
items.description: A Panel with an anatomy: media, header, body and footer, spaced by size; the whole card can be one link or button.

items.name: echo-item
items.title: Item
items.description: The row every list is made of: media, title, description, trailing content, and actions behind it that a swipe or Tab reveals.

items.name: echo-layout
items.title: Stack & Grid
items.description: The two layouts a screen is made of, with gaps on the space scale.

items.name: echo-collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One disclosure on its own: a ruled row with a chevron that opens a panel.

items.name: echo-scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: A region that scrolls inside itself, with a groove and a molded thumb, and shade where the content continues.

items.name: echo-link
items.title: Link
items.description: Inline text that goes somewhere: readable words with the accent as the underline.

items.name: echo-toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: The quiet key of a toolbar: on is the cap held down in its well. ToggleGroup puts several in one well.

items.name: echo-toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Several caps sharing one long well: ButtonGroup, and Toolbar with one tab stop and arrow keys.

items.name: echo-range-slider
items.title: RangeSlider
items.description: Two knobs on one rail for a span, with Slider's weight.

items.name: echo-knob
items.title: Knob
items.description: A molded rotary cap with detents, a lit scale and every slider key.

items.name: echo-tuner
items.title: Tuner
items.description: A number tuned like a radio: a scale slides under a lit needle and a segment reading follows.

items.name: echo-keypad
items.title: Keypad
items.description: A payment terminal's keys: an amount, a PIN or a code entered on HardwareButton caps.

items.name: echo-filter-tray
items.title: FilterTray
items.description: Filter pads in one well that fold into the action when applied.

items.name: echo-week-strip
items.title: WeekStrip
items.description: A week of days to tap through, today on a lit rail, busy days with a pip.

items.name: echo-switch-bank
items.title: SwitchBank
items.description: A table of Switches for settings that come in a grid, a Checkbox per column.

items.name: echo-jog-wheel
items.title: JogWheel
items.description: A knob with no ends: slow for a step, spin for a long way.

items.name: echo-quick-tile
items.title: QuickTile
items.description: A quick-settings tile: a big key that lights when the thing is on.

items.name: echo-fill-slider
items.title: FillSlider
items.description: A tall tube that fills with lit plastic as you push it up.

items.name: echo-patch-bay
items.title: PatchBay
items.description: Sockets on two sides and cables between: a Select per source is the control.

items.name: echo-meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A measurement in a known range: a tube of lit plastic that settles to its level.

items.name: echo-level-meter
items.title: LevelMeter
items.description: A live level as LED cells with real ballistics and a held peak.

items.name: echo-combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A Select you can type into; multiple keeps choices as tags; creatable adds what you typed.

items.name: echo-tags-input
items.title: TagsInput
items.description: Free-form tags typed into Field's well: Enter or a comma adds, Backspace removes.

items.name: echo-fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: A named group of fields with a legend.

items.name: echo-checkbox-group
items.title: CheckboxGroup
items.description: A named set of checkboxes sharing one value, with an optional parent.

items.name: echo-form
items.title: Form
items.description: A form that fails well: a summary of what to fix, each a link to its field.

items.name: echo-hold-button
items.title: HoldButton
items.description: Confirm by holding: the cap fills while pressed and drains if let go.

items.name: echo-choice-cards
items.title: ChoiceCards
items.description: Options that need more than a word, as cards; the chosen one lights its edge.

items.name: echo-side-nav
items.title: SideNav
items.description: The navigation down the side of an app, with one lit rail that travels to where you are.

items.name: echo-tab-bar
items.title: TabBar
items.description: A phone app's bottom navigation: a floating molded dock whose cap travels to the place you're on.

items.name: echo-notification-center
items.title: NotificationCenter
items.description: A bell with the unread count, opening an inbox of notifications.

items.name: echo-pull-to-refresh
items.title: PullToRefresh
items.description: A list you pull down to reload: a rubber band, a key that clicks at the detent, and a real Refresh button beside the gesture.

items.name: echo-console
items.title: Console screen
items.description: A device dashboard as a front panel: AppShell, six StatTile readouts, an LED level matrix, a takes Table and Pagination. Proves density and data at scale.

items.name: echo-chat
items.title: Chat screen
items.description: One conversation as a front panel: Avatar + StatusDot header, a message log, a Loader typing indicator, and a Textarea composer with one lit Send cap. Proves the material language survives running text.

items.name: echo-morph
items.title: Morph
items.description: Wrap your own HardwareButtons and render any state: when the buttons change, the old ones flow into the new. The base for DoneButton, ConfirmButton and ActionFan.

items.name: echo-done-button
items.title: DoneButton
items.description: "Mark as done" divides into a lit "Done" and an "Undo".

items.name: echo-confirm-button
items.title: ConfirmButton
items.description: A destructive action that asks for its second press where the hand already is.

items.name: echo-action-fan
items.title: ActionFan
items.description: One action opens into its choices; the × folds them back.

items.name: echo-save-button
items.title: SaveButton
items.description: The button becomes its own progress, then its own answer: Save narrows into a busy cap while your save runs, widens into a lit Saved, and flows back.

items.name: echo-timer
items.title: Timer
items.description: A timer that is one button.

items.name: echo-stopwatch
items.title: Stopwatch
items.description: Start becomes the running time (lit) and a Lap button beside it; each lap is a drop that leaves Lap and lands in the lap count.

items.name: echo-voice-note
items.title: VoiceNote
items.description: Record a voice note in one button.

items.name: echo-add-to-bag
items.title: AddToBag
items.description: Press it and a drop buds out of the button and lands in the count beside it, which swells and goes up — the eye follows the thing you added to where it went.

items.name: echo-bud-off
items.title: useBudOff
items.description: A drop of the primary plastic buds out of one element, flies to another and is swallowed by it, which swells as it lands — so the eye follows cause to effect.

items.name: echo-pull-cord
items.title: PullCord
items.description: A switch you pull.

items.name: echo-roll
items.title: useRoll
items.description: A readout that rolls to a new value instead of swapping it: each digit steps through the ones in between, all together, fast when it's far and slowest on the last step.

items.name: echo-split-flap
items.title: SplitFlap
items.description: A readout that turns over like a departures board: each character flips through the ones between where it is and where it's going, flap by flap — fast when it's far, slowest on the last one — and each flap ticks.

items.name: echo-light-source
items.title: LightSource
items.description: Your pointer becomes the light the caps inside it are lit by: each HardwareButton's shine turns toward it and its shadow falls away from it, the nearest most.

items.name: echo-magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: The HardwareButtons inside it feel your hand before you touch them: each leans toward the pointer and comes up a little, the nearest most, and springs home when you move away.

items.name: echo-throw-stack
items.title: ThrowStack
items.description: A stack of cards you can throw: drag the top one and flick it, and it keeps the speed you gave it, spins from where you held it (grabbed low, it swings the other way), flies off and tucks back in underneath.

items.name: echo-ripple
items.title: Ripple
items.description: A surface of dots that answers a press like water: a wave runs out from where you pressed, and pressing longer presses deeper and sends a bigger one.
